```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, error = TRUE,
                      dev = "png", dpi = 120)
suppressWarnings(suppressMessages({
  library(plotly); library(DT); library(crosstalk); library(ggplot2); library(htmltools)
}))
B <- readRDS(params$bundle)
cells <- B$cells
# violins only need enough points for the shape; downsample so ggplotly does not
# serialize ~80k cells per widget (that ballooned the file on many-sample runs)
vcells <- {
  set.seed(1)
  idx <- unlist(lapply(split(seq_len(nrow(cells)), cells$sample),
                       function(ix) if (length(ix) > 600) sample(ix, 600) else ix), use.names = FALSE)
  cells[sort(idx), , drop = FALSE]
}
PAL <- {
  cts  <- sort(unique(cells$cell_type))
  base <- c("#4e79a7","#f28e2b","#e15759","#76b7b2","#59a14f","#edc948","#b07aa1",
            "#ff9da7","#9c755f","#bab0ac","#86bcb6","#d37295","#fabfd2","#8cd17d","#499894")
  if (!is.null(B$cell_colors)) {            # canonical CELLTYPE_COLORS from the driver
    p <- unname(B$cell_colors[cts]); miss <- is.na(p)
    if (any(miss)) p[miss] <- rep(base, length.out = sum(miss))
    setNames(p, cts)
  } else setNames(rep(base, length.out = length(cts)), cts)
}
n_samp   <- length(B$samples)
# Past 8 samples the UMAP comparison panels are pre-rendered static snapshots (built
# in the driver), so live zoom and legend-toggling do not apply; the intro text adapts.
STATIC <- isTRUE(B$umap_static) && !is.null(B$umap_panels)

# Redundant, colour-independent encoding for the stacked composition / cell-number bars so
# cell types are not told apart by colour alone (colour-blind- and greyscale-print-safe):
#   - a hatch pattern per cell type, cycling so adjacent stacked segments differ in texture
#   - the cell-type name printed inside each segment, auto-hidden by uniformtext when the
#     segment is too small to fit it (dominant populations get named without needing hover)
# Hover still carries the exact value. Applied after plotly_build so the colour= split into
# one-trace-per-type is already resolved.
CT_PATTERNS <- c("", "/", "\\", "x", "-", "|", "+", ".")
style_ct_bars <- function(p) {
  b <- plotly::plotly_build(p)
  b$x$layout$uniformtext <- list(minsize = 8, mode = "hide")
  k <- 0
  for (i in seq_along(b$x$data)) {
    tr <- b$x$data[[i]]
    if (is.null(tr$type) || tr$type != "bar") next
    b$x$data[[i]]$marker$pattern <- list(
      shape = CT_PATTERNS[(k %% length(CT_PATTERNS)) + 1],
      fillmode = "overlay", size = 7, solidity = 0.28, fgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.32)")
    b$x$data[[i]]$textposition     <- "inside"
    b$x$data[[i]]$insidetextanchor <- "middle"
    b$x$data[[i]]$texttemplate     <- tr$name   # constant per trace = the cell-type label
    b$x$data[[i]]$textfont         <- list(size = 11)
    b$x$data[[i]]$cliponaxis       <- FALSE
    k <- k + 1
  }
  b
}
```

```{css, echo=FALSE}
:root{
  --bg:#f4f6f9; --panel:#fff; --ink:#1f2733; --muted:#667085;
  --line:#e4e8ee; --rail:#1b2230; --rail-ink:#cdd5e0; --accent:#3b82f6;
  --good:#12a150; --warn:#e08a00; --bad:#d23f3f;
  --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.06),0 1px 3px rgba(16,24,40,.10);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
/* clicked nav anchors land below the fixed 52px top bar instead of behind it */
html{scroll-padding-top:68px}
body{font-family:-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
     color:var(--ink);background:var(--bg);font-size:14px;line-height:1.5}
/* hide R Markdown's default title/date header — the title lives in the top bar */
#header,h1.title,.title{display:none}

/* full-width fixed top bar */
.report-top{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:52px;z-index:100;display:flex;
  align-items:center;gap:14px;background:var(--rail);color:#fff;padding:0 18px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.report-top .title{font-weight:600;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.01em;
  max-width:48vw;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.report-top .chip{background:#2b3548;color:var(--rail-ink);border-radius:999px;padding:3px 11px;font-size:12px}
.report-top .meta{margin-left:auto;color:#9aa6b5;font-size:12px;display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center}
.report-top .meta b{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
/* nav toggle lives at the top-right of the nav rail; when collapsed it parks at the page edge */
.navtoggle{position:fixed;top:59px;left:170px;z-index:96;width:30px;height:28px;
  background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--muted);border-radius:7px;
  font-size:14px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:left .15s}
.navtoggle:hover{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent)}
body.nav-collapsed .navtoggle{left:10px}

/* fixed left navigation rail (a panel with a right border, not a card) */
.report-nav{position:fixed;top:52px;left:0;bottom:0;width:208px;background:#fff;
  border-right:1px solid var(--line);padding:10px 0;overflow:auto;z-index:90}
.report-nav a{display:block;padding:9px 18px;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;font-size:13px;
  border-left:3px solid transparent;cursor:pointer}
.report-nav a:hover{background:#f7f9fc;color:var(--ink)}
.report-nav a.active{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;border-left-color:var(--accent);background:#f2f6ff}
.report-nav .grouplabel{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#5b6675;
  font-weight:700;padding:14px 18px 4px}

/* main column clears the fixed top bar + nav; collapsing the nav frees the whole page */
.main-container{margin:52px 0 0 208px !important;max-width:1080px;padding:10px 30px 70px;transition:margin .15s}
body.nav-collapsed .report-nav{display:none}
body.nav-collapsed .main-container{margin-left:auto !important;margin-right:auto}

h1{font-size:20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:6px;margin-top:30px}
h2{font-size:15px;border:0;margin-top:16px}
h1:empty{display:none}  /* the hidden tab-closing header after the galleries */

/* sample cards: compact, label/value stat rows (mockup style) */
.cardgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(196px,1fr));gap:12px;
  margin:10px 0 22px;max-width:880px}
.scard{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:12px 14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.scard h3{margin:0 0 9px;font-size:13.5px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-weight:600}
.scard .tag{font-size:10.5px;color:#fff;background:var(--bad);border-radius:999px;padding:1px 7px;font-weight:600}
.scard .stat{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:2.5px 0;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.scard .stat b{color:var(--ink);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-weight:600}

/* accent tab pills + tables + read line */
.nav-pills>li.active>a,.nav-pills>li.active>a:hover,.nav-pills>li.active>a:focus{background:var(--accent)}
.nav-pills>li>a{color:var(--muted)}
table.dataTable thead th{background:#fafbfd;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
/* overview summary rows deep-link to the per-sample plots */
table.clickrows tbody tr{cursor:pointer}
table.clickrows tbody tr:hover td{background:#f2f6ff}
table.clickrows caption{caption-side:top;text-align:left;color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;padding:0 0 7px}
.read-line{background:#f2f6ff;border-left:3px solid var(--accent);border-radius:6px;
  padding:9px 14px;margin:4px 0 14px;font-size:13.5px}
hr{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
small{color:var(--muted)}

/* sample selector: rounded toggle chips (restyled crosstalk checkbox group), no ticks, no search */
.crosstalk-input{margin:0 0 14px}
.crosstalk-input .control-label{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;
  color:#9aa6b5;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px;display:block}
.crosstalk-input-checkboxgroup .crosstalk-options-group{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.crosstalk-input-checkboxgroup .checkbox{margin:0}
.crosstalk-input-checkboxgroup .checkbox input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:0;height:0;pointer-events:none}
.crosstalk-input-checkboxgroup .checkbox label{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:999px;padding:6px 15px;font-size:13px;background:#fff;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;
  font-weight:500;user-select:none}
.crosstalk-input-checkboxgroup .checkbox label:hover{border-color:#c4ccd8;color:var(--ink)}
.crosstalk-input-checkboxgroup .checkbox label:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--accent);
  background:#f2f6ff;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent)}

/* sample-comparison: chip selector row + UMAP grid (max 3/row) + one shared legend on the side */
.selrow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:10px 0 16px}
.selrow .sellabel{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#9aa6b5;
  font-weight:600;margin-right:4px}
.selchip{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 15px;font-size:13px;
  cursor:pointer;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
.selchip:hover{border-color:#c4ccd8;color:var(--ink)}
.selchip.on{border-color:var(--accent);background:#f2f6ff;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent)}
/* small text controls (Select all / Unselect all) next to the sample chips */
.selctl{background:none;border:0;color:var(--accent);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;
  padding:6px 6px;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px}
.selctl:hover{color:#1d4ed8}
/* visible keyboard focus for the interactive chips, controls and legend toggles */
.selchip:focus-visible,.selctl:focus-visible,.legitem:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
/* Overview column glossary */
.glossary{margin:14px 0 22px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:#fff;padding:4px 14px 12px}
.glossary>summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink);padding:8px 0;list-style:none}
.glossary>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.glossary>summary:before{content:"\25B8 ";color:var(--muted)}
.glossary[open]>summary:before{content:"\25BE "}
.gloss-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:4px 22px}
.gloss-item{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);padding:3px 0;line-height:1.4}
.gloss-item b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;margin-right:5px}
.umapwrap{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start}
.umapgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:16px;flex:1;min-width:0}
/* one visible panel (single-sample run, or all but one chip deselected) spans full width */
.umapgrid.solo{grid-template-columns:1fr}
/* shown when every sample chip is deselected (Unselect all) so the grid is not just blank */
.umapgrid .umapempty{display:none;grid-column:1/-1;padding:30px 14px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);
  font-size:13px;border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:#fff}
.umapgrid.empty .umapempty{display:block}
.umapcell{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:#fff;padding:6px 6px 2px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);min-width:0}
.umaptitle{font-weight:600;font-size:12.5px;padding:3px 6px;color:var(--ink)}
.shlegend{width:158px;flex:none;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:#fff;
  padding:10px 12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);position:sticky;top:64px}
.shlegend .lgtitle{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#9aa6b5;
  font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px}
.legitem{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:4px 2px;font-size:12.5px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink)}
.legitem:hover{color:var(--accent)}
.legitem.off{opacity:.38}
.legitem.static{cursor:default}
.legitem.static:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.legsw{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:3px;flex:none}
.muted-note{color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;margin:0 0 12px;max-width:760px}

/* clickable sample cards (deep-link into the per-sample gallery) */
.scardlink{text-decoration:none;color:inherit;display:block}
.scardlink:hover .scard{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 2px 7px rgba(59,130,246,.16)}

/* one- or two-line grey description printed under a section title */
.plot-desc{color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.45;margin:2px 0 14px;max-width:820px}
/* fixed-width plots scroll inside their own box on a narrow screen, not the whole page */
.hscroll{overflow-x:auto;max-width:100%}
/* long model file names in the labels line wrap instead of widening the page */
.read-line code{overflow-wrap:anywhere}

/* static gallery figures — ONE consistent, bounded width for every per-stage and
   per-sample plot (like the comparison panels; not full-bleed). height:auto keeps each
   plot's own proportions; sources are rendered a touch wider so this never upscales. */
.galfig{margin:10px 0 20px}
.galfig figcaption{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:5px}
.galfig img{width:100%;max-width:680px;height:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:#fff}

/* per-sample plots in a 2-up grid so the section is not an endless single column */
.galgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px 18px;align-items:start}
.galfig figcaption{color:var(--ink);font-size:13px}   /* darker caption vs the grey description */

/* stronger per-section headers in the galleries so samples/stages don't blur together */
#per-sample h2,#galleries h2{margin-top:28px;padding:6px 11px;background:#f2f6ff;
  border-left:3px solid var(--accent);border-radius:6px;font-size:15.5px;color:var(--ink)}

/* WCAG-AA contrast: darken the small on-white labels (the on-dark top-bar meta is left alone) */
.crosstalk-input .control-label,.selrow .sellabel,.shlegend .lgtitle{color:#6b7686}
/* nav group headers darker than their links so RUN / COMPARE / PER SAMPLE read as headers */
.report-nav .grouplabel{color:#3c4350}
.scard .tag{background:#c0392b}

/* frozen-reference benchmark tables (static, small — no widget needed) */
.benchtab{border-collapse:collapse;margin:6px 0 18px;font-size:12.5px}
.benchtab th,.benchtab td{border:1px solid var(--line);padding:4px 11px;text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.benchtab th:first-child,.benchtab td:first-child{text-align:left}
.benchtab thead th{background:#fafbfd;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.benchtab caption{caption-side:top;text-align:left;color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;font-size:13px;padding:8px 0 4px}
.bench-details{margin:4px 0 18px}
.bench-details>summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink);padding:6px 0}

/* label-source toggle (Frozen reference vs De-novo) above the proportion bars */
.lblsrc-toggle{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:8px 0 4px}
.lblsrc-toggle .sellabel{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#6b7686;font-weight:600}

/* responsive: below 820px the fixed 208px rail becomes an off-canvas drawer and every
   multi-column grid collapses to one column (the desktop layout otherwise squeezes the
   main content to a sliver on tablets/phones and overflows wide tables) */
@media (max-width: 820px){
  .report-nav{transform:translateX(-100%);transition:transform .2s ease;width:240px;
    box-shadow:2px 0 12px rgba(16,24,40,.18)}
  body.nav-open .report-nav{transform:none}
  /* the menu button moves into the top bar so it never covers the first line of text */
  .navtoggle{left:12px;top:11px;z-index:101}
  .report-top{padding-left:54px}
  .main-container{margin-left:0 !important;margin-right:auto;padding:10px 16px 60px}
  .report-top .meta{display:none}
  .report-top .title{font-size:14px}
  .cardgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}
  .scard{padding:10px 11px}
  /* stretch: flex-start shrank the stacked UMAP grid to its content width (~60 px panels) */
  .umapwrap{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
  .umapgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .shlegend{position:static;width:auto;top:auto}
  .galgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .galfig img{max-width:100%}
}
```

```{r shell, results='asis'}
top <- sprintf('<div class="report-top"><span class="title" title="%s">%s</span><span class="chip">Interactive run report</span><span class="meta"><span><b>%s</b> cells</span><span><b>%s</b> samples</span><span>%s</span></span></div><button class="navtoggle" title="Show / hide the navigation rail" onclick="document.body.classList.toggle(matchMedia(\'(max-width:820px)\').matches?\'nav-open\':\'nav-collapsed\')">&#9776;</button>',
  htmltools::htmlEscape(B$run_name), htmltools::htmlEscape(B$run_name), format(B$n_cells_total, big.mark=","), n_samp,
  paste(format(Sys.Date(), "%d"), month.abb[as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%m"))], format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")))
slug <- function(x) gsub("(^-|-$)", "", gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", tolower(x)))
gal  <- !isTRUE(B$lite) && !is.null(B$galleries)
stage_links <- if (gal && length(B$galleries$stage)) paste0('<div class="grouplabel">Per stage</div>',
  paste(sprintf('<a href="#stage-%s">%s</a>', slug(names(B$galleries$stage)),
                htmltools::htmlEscape(names(B$galleries$stage))), collapse="")) else ''
sample_links <- if (gal && length(B$galleries$by_sample)) paste0('<div class="grouplabel">Per sample</div>',
  paste(sprintf('<a href="#sample-%s">%s</a>', slug(names(B$galleries$by_sample)),
                htmltools::htmlEscape(names(B$galleries$by_sample))), collapse="")) else ''
# customer-only sections; the headings' pandoc ids are their slugs
cl <- c(if (!is.null(B$cust$eff)) B$cust$eff_spec$title,
        if (!is.null(B$cust$comp)) "Composition statistics",
        if (!is.null(B$cust$de_vol) && nrow(B$cust$de_vol)) "Gene expression changes between groups",
        if (!is.null(B$cust$cor_pb)) "Sample concordance",
        if (!is.null(B$cust$rho)) "Ambient RNA",
        if (!is.null(B$cust$qc_png)) "Per-sample quality detail")
cust_links <- if (length(cl)) paste0('<div class="grouplabel">Results</div>',
  paste(sprintf('<a href="#%s">%s</a>', slug(cl), sub(" between groups", "", cl)), collapse = "")) else ''
nav <- paste0('<nav class="report-nav">',
  '<div class="grouplabel">Run</div><a href="#overview">Overview</a>',
  '<div class="grouplabel">Compare</div>',
  '<a href="#sample-comparison">Sample comparison</a>',
  '<a href="#cell-proportions">Cell proportions</a>',
  '<a href="#cell-type-markers">Cell-type markers</a>',
  if (!is.null(B$benchmark)) '<a href="#benchmark">Frozen-ref benchmark</a>' else '',
  cust_links,
  stage_links, sample_links,
  '<div class="grouplabel">About</div>',
  if (!is.null(B$cust$xlsx)) '<a href="#downloads">Downloads</a>' else '',
  '<a href="#versions">Versions</a>',
  '</nav>')
cat(top, nav)
```

```{r intro, results='asis'}
cat(if (STATIC)
  'Each UMAP comparison panel is a high-resolution static snapshot (live zoom and legend-toggling apply automatically to runs of 8 samples or fewer). Hover the violins and bar charts for values, and drag to zoom. '
else
  'Hover any plot for values, drag to zoom, and click a cell type in a legend to toggle it across every panel — that toggle <em>is</em> the depletion view. ')
cat(sprintf('Source: <code>integrated_annotated.rds</code> (reduction <code>%s</code>) + the QC tables. No data is recomputed.',
            htmltools::htmlEscape(B$umap_name)))
# which reference labelled the cells: names come from the run, never from this template
nm <- function(x) if (length(x) && !is.na(x[1]) && nzchar(x[1])) x[1] else "unrecorded"
lab <- if (identical(B$label_source, "ref")) {
  sprintf('a <b>frozen reference</b> model, <code>%s</code>, so the labels do not shift with the sample mix',
          htmltools::htmlEscape(basename(nm(B$ref_model))))
} else
  sprintf('this run&rsquo;s own annotation (SingleR against <code>%s</code>, then marker curation), so the labels can shift when the sample mix changes',
          htmltools::htmlEscape(nm(B$singler_ref)))
cat(sprintf('<div class="read-line"><b>Cell-type labels</b> (%s): %s.</div>',
            htmltools::htmlEscape(nm(B$species)), lab))
```

# Overview

```{r cards, results='asis'}
S <- B$summary
fmt <- function(x, d=0) ifelse(is.na(x), "—", formatC(round(as.numeric(x), d), big.mark=",", format="f", digits=d))
row <- function(l, v) sprintf('<div class="stat"><span>%s</span><b>%s</b></div>', l, v)
cards <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(S)), function(i) {
  r <- S[i, ]
  # Low QC = the cells that passed are poor (median genes < 500) or the library is
  # mostly ambient (SoupX rho > 0.3). Retention is deliberately not a criterion: it
  # measures how many barcodes the caller over-called, not cell quality (see 08b).
  rho <- if (!is.null(r$Ambient_rho)) r$Ambient_rho else NA
  low <- (!is.na(r$Median_genes) && r$Median_genes < 500) || (!is.na(rho) && rho > 0.3)
  why <- if (!is.na(rho) && rho > 0.3) sprintf(" (ambient %.0f%%)", 100 * rho) else ""
  tag <- if (low) sprintf(' <span class="tag">low QC%s</span>', why) else ''
  stats <- paste0(
    row("Cells", fmt(r$Cells)),
    row("% retained", paste0(fmt(r$Pct_retained,1), "%")),
    row("Median genes", fmt(r$Median_genes)),
    row("Median UMI", fmt(r$Median_UMI)),
    row("% MT", paste0(fmt(r$Median_pct_MT,1), "%")),
    if (!is.null(r$Doublet_pct) && !is.na(r$Doublet_pct)) row("Doublets", paste0(fmt(r$Doublet_pct,1), "%")) else "",
    if (!is.null(r$HVG) && !is.na(r$HVG)) row("HVG", fmt(r$HVG)) else "",
    row("Cell types", fmt(r$N_cell_types)))
  card <- sprintf('<div class="scard"><h3>%s%s</h3>%s</div>', htmltools::htmlEscape(r$Sample), tag, stats)
  slug <- function(x) gsub("(^-|-$)", "", gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", tolower(x)))
  has_gal <- !isTRUE(B$lite) && !is.null(B$galleries) && r$Sample %in% names(B$galleries$by_sample)
  if (has_gal) sprintf('<a class="scardlink" href="#sample-%s">%s</a>', slug(r$Sample), card) else card
}, character(1))
cat('<div class="cardgrid">', paste(cards, collapse=""), '</div>')
```

```{r summary_table}
S2 <- B$summary
S2$Ambient_rho <- NULL   # drives the low-QC tag only; rho has its own section in the customer report
nm  <- c(Sample="Sample", Cells="Cells", Median_genes="Median genes", Median_UMI="Median UMI",
         Median_pct_MT="Median %MT", Median_pct_ribo="Median %ribo", Pct_retained="% retained",
         Doublet_pct="Doublet %", HVG="HVG", N_cell_types="Cell types", Top_type="Top type")
names(S2) <- ifelse(names(S2) %in% names(nm), nm[names(S2)], names(S2))
roundable <- intersect(c("Median %MT","Median %ribo","% retained","Doublet %"), names(S2))
# clickable rows: jump to that sample's per-sample plots (same slug as the section ids)
gal_ok <- !isTRUE(B$lite) && !is.null(B$galleries) && length(B$galleries$by_sample)
cb <- DT::JS(
  "var slugify=function(s){return String(s).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-').replace(/^-|-$/g,'');};",
  "table.on('click','tbody tr',function(){",
  "  var d=table.row(this).data(); if(!d) return;",
  "  var id='sample-'+slugify(d[0]);",
  "  if(document.getElementById(id)){location.hash=id;}",
  "});")
datatable(S2, rownames = FALSE,
          class = if (gal_ok) "compact stripe hover clickrows" else "compact stripe hover",
          caption = if (gal_ok) "Click a row to open that sample's detailed plots below." else NULL,
          selection = "single",
          # DT >= 0.34 rejects callback = NULL ("only accept a value returned from
          # JS()"), which broke this whole table under --lite where gal_ok is FALSE.
          # A no-op JS keeps the argument type valid when there are no galleries
          # to jump to.
          callback = if (gal_ok) cb else DT::JS("return table;"),
          options = list(dom = "t", paging = FALSE, ordering = TRUE, scrollX = TRUE)) |>
  formatRound(roundable, 1)
```

```{r glossary, results='asis'}
thr <- if (is.null(B$hvg_var_threshold)) 1.3 else B$hvg_var_threshold
defs <- c(
  "Cells"                = "Cells passing QC filtering and doublet removal.",
  "% retained"           = "Percentage of input GEM barcodes kept after QC and doublet removal. The low-QC tag on a sample card instead counts from barcodes that cleared the minimum-genes floor, so a permissive barcode caller does not flag a healthy sample.",
  "Median genes"         = "Median number of genes detected per cell (nFeature_RNA).",
  "Median UMI"           = "Median transcript (UMI) count per cell (nCount_RNA).",
  "% MT (Median %MT)"    = "Median fraction of reads from mitochondrial genes per cell; high values flag stressed or dying cells.",
  "Median %ribo"         = "Median fraction of reads from ribosomal genes per cell.",
  "Doublets (Doublet %)" = "Percentage of cells flagged as multiplets by scDblFinder and removed before integration.",
  "HVG"                  = sprintf("Highly Variable Genes: genes with vst standardized variance &gt; %s.", thr),
  "Cell types"           = "Number of distinct annotated cell types in the sample.",
  "Top type"             = "Most abundant cell type in the sample.")
items <- paste(sprintf('<div class="gloss-item"><b>%s</b><span>%s</span></div>',
                       htmltools::htmlEscape(names(defs)), defs), collapse = "")
cat(sprintf('<details class="glossary" open><summary>What the columns mean</summary><div class="gloss-grid">%s</div></details>', items))
```

# Sample comparison {.tabset .tabset-pills}

Pick a metric below, then choose which samples to compare with the chips. Every panel shares the
integrated coordinate space, so a depleted population shows up as the same hole across samples.

## UMAP

```{r umap_grid}
slugv  <- function(x) gsub("(^-|-$)", "", gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", tolower(x)))
cts    <- sort(unique(cells$cell_type))
static <- isTRUE(B$umap_static) && !is.null(B$umap_panels)

if (static) {
  # many-sample runs: light static PNG panels (no 14x WebGL contexts / 16 MB of JSON)
  panels <- lapply(B$samples, function(s)
    htmltools::div(class = "umapcell", id = paste0("umapwrap-", slugv(s)),
      htmltools::div(class = "umaptitle", s),
      htmltools::tags$img(src = B$umap_panels[[s]], alt = sprintf("UMAP of %s", s),
                          style = "width:100%;display:block;border-radius:6px")))
} else {
  htext <- if (isTRUE(B$label_source == "ref"))
    ~paste0(cell_type, "<br>de-novo: ", cell_type_denovo) else ~cell_type
  mk_umap <- function(s) {
    dd <- cells[cells$sample == s, , drop = FALSE]
    nc <- B$summary$Cells[match(s, B$summary$Sample)]; if (is.na(nc)) nc <- nrow(dd)
    plot_ly(dd, x = ~UMAP_1, y = ~UMAP_2, color = ~cell_type, colors = PAL,
            type = "scattergl", mode = "markers",
            marker = list(size = 4, opacity = 0.8),
            text = htext, hoverinfo = "text", showlegend = FALSE, height = 360) |>
      layout(title = list(text = sprintf("%s  (%s cells)", s, format(nc, big.mark = ",")),
                          x = 0.03, y = 0.97, font = list(size = 13)),
             xaxis = list(title = "UMAP 1", zeroline = FALSE, showticklabels = FALSE),
             yaxis = list(title = "UMAP 2", zeroline = FALSE, showticklabels = FALSE),
             margin = list(l = 42, r = 8, t = 30, b = 36)) |>
      toWebGL()
  }
  panels <- lapply(B$samples, function(s)
    htmltools::div(class = "umapcell", id = paste0("umapwrap-", slugv(s)),
                   htmltools::div(class = "umaptitle", s), mk_umap(s)))
}
chips <- lapply(B$samples, function(s)
  htmltools::tags$button(class = "selchip on", `data-sample` = slugv(s), `aria-pressed` = "true", s))
legitems <- lapply(cts, function(ct)
  htmltools::tags$div(class = if (static) "legitem static" else "legitem", `data-ct` = ct,
    role = if (static) NULL else "button", tabindex = if (static) NULL else "0",
    `aria-pressed` = if (static) NULL else "true",
    htmltools::tags$span(class = "legsw", style = sprintf("background:%s", PAL[[ct]])),
    htmltools::tags$span(ct)))
js_solo <- "var _wasSolo=null;function umResize(c,solo){var w=c.querySelector('.html-widget'),p=c.querySelector('.js-plotly-plot');if(w)w.style.height=(solo?700:360)+'px';if(p&&window.Plotly){try{Plotly.Plots.resize(p);}catch(e){}}}function umSolo(){var g=document.querySelector('.umapgrid');if(!g)return;var n=0;Array.prototype.forEach.call(g.children,function(c){if(c.classList.contains('umapcell')&&c.style.display!=='none')n++;});g.classList.toggle('empty',n===0);var solo=n===1;g.classList.toggle('solo',solo);if(solo===_wasSolo)return;_wasSolo=solo;requestAnimationFrame(function(){Array.prototype.forEach.call(g.children,function(c){if(c.style.display!=='none')umResize(c,solo);});});}"
js_chip <- "document.querySelectorAll('.selrow .selchip[data-sample]').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){var on=b.classList.toggle('on');b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',on);var w=document.getElementById('umapwrap-'+b.getAttribute('data-sample'));if(w){w.style.display=on?'':'none';if(on)requestAnimationFrame(function(){var p=w.querySelector('.js-plotly-plot');if(p&&window.Plotly){try{Plotly.Plots.resize(p);}catch(e){}}});}umSolo();});});"
# Select all / Unselect all controls for the UMAP sample chips
js_ctl <- "document.querySelectorAll('.selrow .selctl').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){var on=b.getAttribute('data-act')==='all';document.querySelectorAll('.selrow .selchip[data-sample]').forEach(function(ch){ch.classList.toggle('on',on);ch.setAttribute('aria-pressed',on);var w=document.getElementById('umapwrap-'+ch.getAttribute('data-sample'));if(w){w.style.display=on?'':'none';if(on&&window.Plotly){var p=w.querySelector('.js-plotly-plot');if(p){try{Plotly.Plots.resize(p);}catch(e){}}}}});umSolo();});});"
js_leg  <- if (static) "" else "document.querySelectorAll('.shlegend .legitem').forEach(function(it){function tog(){var off=it.classList.toggle('off');it.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(!off));var name=it.getAttribute('data-ct');document.querySelectorAll('.umapgrid .js-plotly-plot').forEach(function(gd){if(!gd.data) return;var idx=[];gd.data.forEach(function(t,i){if(t.name===name) idx.push(i);});if(idx.length&&window.Plotly) Plotly.restyle(gd,{visible:off?'legendonly':true},idx);});}it.addEventListener('click',tog);it.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key===' '||e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();tog();}});});"
# Re-fit visible UMAPs when the window is resized or dragged to a screen with a different
# pixel density. Plotly.Plots.resize skips when it thinks the CSS size is unchanged, so on a
# devicePixelRatio change we force a full redraw — otherwise a solo panel stays stuck at the
# old monitor's resolution until you toggle a *different* sample. Interactive (<=8 sample) path
# only; static PNG panels already scale with their container via CSS.
js_resize <- if (static) "" else "var _dpr=window.devicePixelRatio;function umRefit(force){document.querySelectorAll('.umapgrid .umapcell').forEach(function(c){if(c.style.display==='none')return;var p=c.querySelector('.js-plotly-plot');if(p&&window.Plotly){try{Plotly.Plots.resize(p);if(force)Plotly.redraw(p);}catch(e){}}});}var _rt;window.addEventListener('resize',function(){clearTimeout(_rt);_rt=setTimeout(function(){var d=window.devicePixelRatio!==_dpr;_dpr=window.devicePixelRatio;umRefit(d);},150);});function _watchDpr(){try{var mq=window.matchMedia('(resolution: '+window.devicePixelRatio+'dppx)');mq.addEventListener('change',function(){_dpr=window.devicePixelRatio;umRefit(true);_watchDpr();},{once:true});}catch(e){}}_watchDpr();"
note <- if (static) htmltools::tags$p(class = "muted-note",
  sprintf("%d samples: panels are high-resolution static snapshots (live zoom + legend toggle kick in automatically for runs of 8 samples or fewer). Use the chips to show or hide samples.", length(B$samples))) else NULL
ctl <- htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::tags$button(class = "selctl", `data-act` = "all", "Select all"),
  htmltools::tags$button(class = "selctl", `data-act` = "none", "Unselect all"))
htmltools::browsable(htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::div(class = "selrow", htmltools::tags$span(class = "sellabel", "Samples"), chips, ctl),
  note,
  htmltools::div(class = "umapwrap",
    htmltools::div(class = "umapgrid",
      htmltools::div(class = "umapempty",
        "No samples selected — pick one or more chips above, or use Select all."),
      panels),
    htmltools::div(class = "shlegend",
      htmltools::div(class = "lgtitle", "Cell type"), legitems)),
  htmltools::tags$script(htmltools::HTML(sprintf("(function(){%s%s%s%s%s umSolo();})();",
    js_solo, js_chip, js_leg, js_ctl, js_resize)))
))
```

Click a sample chip to add or drop its panel. Click a cell type in the shared legend to toggle it
across every UMAP at once (e.g. isolate one population to compare it across samples).

## QC

<p class="plot-desc">Distribution of genes detected, UMIs and mitochondrial % per cell, one violin per sample
(PDF style — no scatter dots). Hover for the median and quartiles; compare spreads to spot
low-complexity or high-MT samples. Drag to zoom.</p>

```{r qc_violin}
# Use ggplot geom_violin(scale="width") — the SAME engine as the pipeline's Seurat
# VlnPlot (01_load_qc.R) — so the violin shapes match Overall_Report.pdf exactly.
# trim=TRUE clips the density to the data range; no jitter points (PDF style).
long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("nFeature_RNA","nCount_RNA","percent.mt"), function(m)
  data.frame(sample = vcells$sample, metric = m, value = vcells[[m]])))
long$metric <- factor(long$metric, levels = c("nFeature_RNA","nCount_RNA","percent.mt"),
                      labels = c("Genes / cell","UMIs / cell","% mito"))
gv <- ggplot(long, aes(sample, value, fill = sample)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", trim = TRUE, linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none",
        axis.title = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
ggplotly(gv, height = 430, tooltip = "y")
```

```{r qc_thresholds, results="asis"}
}
```

## Composition

```{r prop_bar}
mk_comp <- function(pl) {
  pb <- plot_ly(pl, x = ~sample, y = ~pct, color = ~cell_type, colors = PAL,
                type = "bar", text = ~paste0(cell_type, ": ", round(pct,1), "%"),
                hoverinfo = "text", height = 470) |>
    layout(barmode = "stack", yaxis = list(title = "% of sample"),
           xaxis = list(title = ""), legend = list(title = list(text = "Cell type")),
           updatemenus = list(list(type = "buttons", direction = "right",
             x = 0, y = 1.08, xanchor = "left", showactive = FALSE, pad = list(t = 2),
             buttons = list(
               list(label = "Show all", method = "restyle", args = list("visible", TRUE)),
               list(label = "Hide all", method = "restyle", args = list("visible", "legendonly"))))))
  pb <- style_ct_bars(pb)
  pb$width <- "100%"   # printed bare, knitr fixes the widget at 840 px and the page scrolls on a phone
  pb
}
if (isTRUE(B$label_source == "ref") && !is.null(B$prop_long_denovo)) {
  htmltools::browsable(htmltools::tagList(
    htmltools::div(class = "lblsrc-ref", mk_comp(B$prop_long)),
    htmltools::div(class = "lblsrc-denovo", style = "display:none", mk_comp(B$prop_long_denovo))))
} else mk_comp(B$prop_long)
```

Each segment is labelled with its cell type where it is large enough to fit (and textured per type, so
the bars read without relying on colour); hover any segment for the exact value. Click a cell type in
the legend to drop it from the bars (or **Hide all**, then click one back on).
A cell type that should be absent from a sample (for example myeloid cells in a lymphocyte sort, or an
off-target lineage in a differentiation) reads directly as carry-over or contamination here.

## Change (delta)

```{r prop_delta}
if (is.null(B$delta)) {
  cat("The pre→post delta table is shown for two-sample runs. This run has",
      length(B$samples), "samples — use the composition bars above to compare.")
} else {
  d <- B$delta; ss <- attr(d, "samples")
  big <- d[which.max(abs(d$delta_pts)), ]
  read <- sprintf('<div class="read-line"><b>Read:</b> %s moves from %.1f%% (%s) to %.1f%% (%s), a change of %+.1f points — the largest shift.</div>',
                  htmltools::htmlEscape(big$cell_type), big[[2]], ss[1], big[[3]], ss[2], big$delta_pts)
  dd <- datatable(d, rownames = FALSE,
                  colnames = c("Cell type", paste(ss[1], "%"), paste(ss[2], "%"), "Δ pts"),
                  class = "compact stripe hover",
                  options = list(dom = "t", paging = FALSE, scrollX = TRUE, order = list(list(3, "asc")))) |>
    formatStyle("delta_pts",
                color = styleInterval(c(-5, 5), c("#c0392b", "#555", "#1e8449")),
                fontWeight = "bold")
  htmltools::tagList(htmltools::HTML(read), dd)
}
```

# Cell-type markers

Canonical marker panel across the annotated types — dot **size** is the % of cells in that type
expressing the gene, **colour** is the scaled average expression. This is the evidence behind the
labels: each type should light up its own marker genes and few others.

```{r marker_dot}
md_ <- B$markers_dot
if (is.null(md_) || !nrow(md_)) {
  cat("Marker dot plot is unavailable for this run.")
} else {
  go <- attr(md_, "gene_order"); if (is.null(go)) go <- unique(md_$gene)
  md_$gene <- factor(md_$gene, levels = go)
  md_$cell_type <- factor(md_$cell_type, levels = rev(sort(unique(md_$cell_type))))
  gp <- ggplot(md_, aes(gene, cell_type, size = pct_exp, color = avg_scaled,
                 text = paste0("<b>", gene, "</b> in ", cell_type, "<br>",
                               round(pct_exp), "% expressing<br>scaled avg ", round(avg_scaled, 2)))) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "scaled avg") +
    scale_size(range = c(0, 6), name = "% expressing") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 10.5),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10.5),
          axis.title = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#f0f0f0"))
  # hscroll: one gene per column cannot shrink to a phone, so below ~16 px a gene the plot
  # stops shrinking and scrolls in its own box instead of overlapping the gene labels
  htmltools::browsable(htmltools::div(class = "hscroll",
    htmltools::div(style = sprintf("min-width:%dpx", 16 * length(go) + 230),
      ggplotly(gp, tooltip = "text", height = max(360, 26 * nlevels(md_$cell_type) + 150)) |>
        layout(xaxis = list(automargin = TRUE), yaxis = list(automargin = TRUE)))))
}
```

```{r cust_comp_head, results='asis', eval=!is.null(B$cust$comp)}
    "tested on the replicate libraries rather than on cells (thousands of cells from one library are ",
    "not independent). A comparison <em>A vs B</em> uses B as the reference: <strong>Reference %</strong> ",
    "is B, <strong>Compared %</strong> is A, and \"up\" means higher in A. <strong>FDR</strong> is the ",
    "false-discovery-rate adjusted p-value across all tests; below 0.05 is called a change. With two ",
    "libraries per group the test has little power, so a large shift that is not called significant ",
    "is <em>uncertain</em>, not absent. Groups with a single library are not tested.",
    if (!is.null(B$cust$contrasts)) " Only the comparisons the study design supports are shown." else "",
    "</p>\n", sep = "")
```

```{r cust_de, eval=!is.null(B$cust$de_vol) && nrow(B$cust$de_vol) > 0}
V <- B$cust$de_vol; N <- attr(V, "n")
V$key <- paste(V$cell_type, V$comparison, sep = "|"); N$key <- paste(N$cell_type, N$comparison, sep = "|")
first <- N$key[which.max(N$up + N$down)]
p <- plot_ly(height = 470)
for (k in unique(V$key)) {
  x <- V[V$key == k, ]; x <- x[order(x$sig), ]   # significant genes drawn on top
  p <- add_trace(p, x = x$avg_log2FC, y = x$nl10, text = x$gene, name = k, visible = k == first,
                 # SVG, not scattergl: the UMAP grid already holds most of the browser's WebGL
                 # contexts, and one visible 600-point panel needs no GPU
                 type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
                 marker = list(size = 5, opacity = 0.8,
                               color = ifelse(!x$sig, "#c8c8c8", ifelse(x$avg_log2FC > 0, "#c0392b", "#2c6fbb"))),
                 hovertemplate = "<b>%{text}</b><br>log2 fold change %{x}<br>−log10 FDR %{y}<extra></extra>")
}
p <- layout(p, showlegend = FALSE,
            xaxis = list(title = "log2 fold change (A vs reference B)", zeroline = FALSE),
            yaxis = list(title = "−log10 FDR"),
            shapes = list(
              list(type = "line", x0 = -1, x1 = -1, y0 = 0, y1 = 1, yref = "paper", line = list(dash = "dot", color = "#999", width = 1)),
              list(type = "line", x0 = 1, x1 = 1, y0 = 0, y1 = 1, yref = "paper", line = list(dash = "dot", color = "#999", width = 1)),
              list(type = "line", x0 = 0, x1 = 1, xref = "paper", y0 = -log10(0.05), y1 = -log10(0.05), line = list(dash = "dot", color = "#999", width = 1))))
# Build once and slim: plotly copies hovertemplate onto every point and keeps an unbuilt copy
# of the data in attrs, which tripled this widget (5.8 MB -> ~1.5 MB on 54 panels).
p <- plotly_build(p); p$x$attrs <- NULL
p$width <- "100%"   # knitr's default is a fixed 840 px, which scrolls the whole page on a phone
p$x$data <- lapply(p$x$data, function(t) { t$hovertemplate <- t$hovertemplate[1]
                                           t[c("error_x", "error_y", "line")] <- NULL; t })
opt <- function(v, sel) paste(sprintf("<option value='%s'%s>%s</option>", htmltools::htmlEscape(v),
                                      ifelse(v == sel, " selected", ""), htmltools::htmlEscape(gsub("_", " ", v))), collapse = "")
f1 <- strsplit(first, "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
cnt <- jsonlite::toJSON(setNames(lapply(seq_len(nrow(N)), function(i) c(N$up[i], N$down[i])), N$key))
htmltools::browsable(htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::HTML(sprintf(paste0("<div class='selrow'><span class='sellabel'>Cell type</span>",
    "<select id='de-ct'>%s</select><span class='sellabel'>Contrast</span><select id='de-cmp'>%s</select>",
    "<span id='de-n' class='sellabel' style='margin-left:12px'></span></div>"),
    opt(sort(unique(V$cell_type)), f1[1]), opt(sort(unique(V$comparison)), f1[2]))),
  htmltools::div(id = "devol", p),
  htmltools::tags$script(htmltools::HTML(sprintf(paste0(
    "(function(){var N=%s;function upd(){var k=document.getElementById('de-ct').value+'|'+",
    "document.getElementById('de-cmp').value;var n=N[k],el=document.getElementById('de-n');",
    "el.textContent=n?(n[0]+' up, '+n[1]+' down'):'not tested for this cell type';",
    "var gd=document.querySelector('#devol .js-plotly-plot');if(gd&&gd.data&&window.Plotly)",
    "Plotly.restyle(gd,{visible:gd.data.map(function(t){return t.name===k;})});}",
    "['de-ct','de-cmp'].forEach(function(id){document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('change',upd);});",
    "upd();})();"), cnt)))))
```

```{r cust_cor, results='asis', eval=!is.null(B$cust$cor_pb)}
cat("# Sample concordance\n\n",
    "<p class='plot-desc'>Each sample's counts summed into a single expression profile, then ",
    "compared with every other sample (Spearman correlation on log-CPM). Replicates of the same ",
    "condition should be each other's closest match; a sample whose closest match is in the ",
    "<em>wrong</em> group is the signature of a swapped or mislabelled library, which nothing ",
    "downstream detects on its own. Hover any cell for the pair and its correlation.</p>\n",
    "<p class='plot-desc' style='font-size:.9em;color:#666'><strong>Note on notation.</strong> ",
    "This is Spearman's <em>r</em>, a similarity between samples running to 1.00. It is unrelated ",
    "to the <em>rho</em> in the Ambient RNA section below, which is a contamination fraction. ",
    "Both are conventionally written with the same Greek letter, so this report uses ",
    "<em>r</em> here and <em>rho</em> there.</p>\n", sep = "")
```

```{r cust_rho_head, results='asis', eval=!is.null(B$cust$rho)}
cat("# Ambient RNA\n\n",
    "<p class='plot-desc'>Some RNA floats free in the cell suspension and is captured alongside ",
    "real cells, so highly expressed genes can appear in cells that never transcribed them. ",
    "<strong>rho</strong> is the estimated fraction of each library's counts coming from that ",
    "free-floating pool, measured with SoupX. Below about 0.05 it is negligible; from roughly ",
    "0.3 upward a library's apparent composition should be treated with caution, because the ",
    "contamination is shared across every cell type. Correction subtracts those counts from ",
    "every cell rather than removing cells, but a cell left with too few genes or UMIs no longer ",
    "meets this run's quality floor. <strong>Cells passing QC</strong> counts the cells that clear ",
    "that floor before and after correction; the median columns show what a typical cell keeps. ",
    "Sort any column.</p>\n", sep = "")
```

```{r cust_rho, eval=!is.null(B$cust$rho)}
rh <- B$cust$rho
# Bands are deliberately blunt at the top end. A library at rho 0.5+ is mostly
# ambient signal: correcting it does not recover the sample, it reconstructs a
# minority of it, biased toward whatever dominated the soup. Saying "interpret
# with caution" there would understate a result that should stop the analysis.
band <- function(x) if (is.na(x)) "not estimated (SoupX rejected its fit)" else
                    if (x < 0.05) "negligible" else if (x < 0.15) "low" else
                    if (x < 0.30) "moderate" else
                    if (x < 0.50) "high — interpret with caution" else
                    "UNSUITABLE — recommend excluding this sample"
tb <- data.frame(Sample = rh$sample,
                 rho = round(rh$rho, 3),
                 `% of counts ambient` = round(100 * rh$rho, 1),
                 check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# Older soupx_rho.csv files carry rho only; the per-cell columns appear when present.
.n  <- function(x) format(round(x), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
.ba <- function(b, a) ifelse(is.na(a), sprintf("%s → not corrected", .n(b)), sprintf("%s → %s", .n(b), .n(a)))
# (all-NA when the run has no qc_thresholds.csv to count against)
if (all(c("cells_qc_before", "cells_qc_after") %in% names(rh)) && !all(is.na(rh$cells_qc_before))) {
  # SoupX never drops a cell, but a corrected cell can fall below the run's QC floor.
  tb$`Cells passing QC (before → after)` <- ifelse(is.na(rh$cells_qc_after),
    sprintf("%s → not corrected", .n(rh$cells_qc_before)),
    sprintf("%s → %s (%s%%)", .n(rh$cells_qc_before), .n(rh$cells_qc_after),
            round(100 * rh$cells_qc_after / rh$cells_qc_before)))
} else if ("cells" %in% names(rh)) tb$Cells <- as.integer(rh$cells)   # numeric so the column sorts
if (all(c("med_umi_before", "med_umi_after") %in% names(rh)))
  tb$`Median UMIs/cell (before → after)` <- .ba(rh$med_umi_before, rh$med_umi_after)
if (all(c("med_genes_before", "med_genes_after") %in% names(rh)))
  tb$`Median genes/cell (before → after)` <- .ba(rh$med_genes_before, rh$med_genes_after)
tb$Assessment <- vapply(rh$rho, band, character(1))
datatable(tb, rownames = FALSE, class = "compact stripe hover", selection = "none",
          callback = DT::JS("return table;"),
          options = list(dom = "t", paging = FALSE, ordering = TRUE, scrollX = TRUE,
                         order = list(list(1, "desc")),   # worst sample first
                         columnDefs = list(list(className = "dt-right", targets = seq_len(ncol(tb) - 2))))) |>
  formatStyle("rho", backgroundColor = styleInterval(c(0.05, 0.15, 0.30, 0.50),
              c("#f1f8f3", "#fdf6e3", "#fdeee3", "#fbe3e3", "#f5c6c6")),
              fontWeight = styleInterval(0.50, c("normal", "bold"))) |>
  formatStyle("Assessment", fontWeight = styleEqual(
              "UNSUITABLE — recommend excluding this sample", "bold"),
              color = styleEqual("UNSUITABLE — recommend excluding this sample", "#8a1c1c"))
```

```{r benchmark, results='asis', eval=!is.null(B$benchmark) && !isTRUE(B$customer)}
BM  <- B$benchmark
esc <- htmltools::htmlEscape
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0 || (length(a) == 1 && is.na(a))) b else a
# small static HTML table; `style` is an optional per-row vector of <td> style attrs for col 1..n
htab <- function(df, caption = NULL, cellstyle = NULL) {
  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) return("")
  hd <- paste0("<th>", esc(names(df)), "</th>", collapse = "")
  rows <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    tds <- vapply(seq_along(df), function(j) {
      st <- if (!is.null(cellstyle)) cellstyle(i, j, df) else ""
      sprintf('<td%s>%s</td>', if (nzchar(st)) sprintf(' style="%s"', st) else "",
              esc(as.character(df[i, j])))
    }, character(1))
    paste0("<tr>", paste(tds, collapse = ""), "</tr>")
  }, character(1))
  cap <- if (is.null(caption)) "" else sprintf("<caption>%s</caption>", esc(caption))
  sprintf('<table class="benchtab">%s<thead><tr>%s</tr></thead><tbody>%s</tbody></table>',
          cap, hd, paste(rows, collapse = ""))
}

cat('\n# Frozen-reference benchmark {#benchmark}\n\n')
pass <- grepl("^PASS", BM$verdict %||% "")
vcol <- if (pass) "var(--good)" else "var(--bad)"
cat(sprintf('<div class="read-line" style="border-left-color:%s"><b>Verdict:</b> %s</div>\n',
            vcol, esc(BM$verdict %||% "(see benchmark_report.md)")))
cat('Cells were classified against a **frozen reference** (built once from a canonical run), so these labels (`cell_type_ref`) are *run-independent*: they do not shift with this run\'s sample mix. The anchor samples carried into every run are the reproducibility control — identical input + same model should give the same proportions across runs, so any drift is a pipeline/run artifact, not biology.\n\n')
if (!is.null(BM$model) && !is.na(BM$model))
  cat(sprintf('<p class="plot-desc">Reference model: <code>%s</code></p>\n', esc(BM$model)))

# ---- concordance, one sub-table per anchor, sorted by |drift|, drift cells flagged red ----
conc <- BM$concordance
if (!is.null(conc) && nrow(conc)) {
  cat('<h2>Anchor concordance vs frozen baseline</h2>\n')
  cat('<p class="plot-desc">Each anchor\'s composition in THIS run (run %) against the reference\'s stored baseline. &Delta;pp is the gap; a flagged row exceeds the drift threshold.</p>\n')
  dcol <- which(names(conc) == "delta_pp"); fcol <- which(names(conc) == "flag")
  style_fn <- function(i, j, df) {
    flagged <- length(fcol) && !is.na(df[i, fcol]) && nzchar(as.character(df[i, fcol]))
    if (length(dcol) && j == dcol) sprintf("font-weight:600;color:%s",
        if (flagged) "var(--bad)" else if (abs(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[i, j]))) < 2) "var(--good)" else "var(--warn)")
    else ""
  }
  for (a in unique(conc$anchor)) {
    sub <- conc[conc$anchor == a, setdiff(names(conc), "anchor"), drop = FALSE]
    sub <- sub[order(-abs(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub$delta_pp)))), , drop = FALSE]
    cat(htab(sub, caption = sprintf("%s", a), cellstyle = style_fn))
  }
}

# ---- whole-blood / sort-status signature ----
# only a blood reference has these labels; elsewhere 08c writes all-zero columns
sig <- BM$signature
wb <- intersect(c("Neutrophil", "RBC", "Platelet"), names(sig))
if (!is.null(sig) && nrow(sig) && length(wb) &&
    any(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(sig[wb]))) > 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  cat('<h2>Whole-blood signature (sort readout)</h2>\n')
  cat('<p class="plot-desc">Granulocyte / RBC / platelet fractions per sample under the frozen reference. High values indicate presort / whole blood; depleted values indicate postsort PBMC.</p>\n')
  cat(htab(sig))
}

# ---- full run-independent composition, collapsed ----
comp <- BM$composition
if (!is.null(comp) && nrow(comp)) {
  cat('<details class="bench-details"><summary>Full run-independent composition (cell_type_ref %, per sample)</summary>\n')
  cat(htab(comp))
  cat('</details>\n')
}
```

```{r galleries, results='asis'}
# Emit real markdown headers (not raw <h1>/<h2>) so pandoc CLOSES the proportions
# {.tabset} above. Raw HTML headers left the galleries trapped inside the last (hidden)
# tab-pane, so anchor links to them could not scroll. {#id} sets the nav/card targets.
if (!isTRUE(B$lite) && !is.null(B$galleries)) {
  G <- B$galleries
  slug <- function(x) gsub("(^-|-$)", "", gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", tolower(x)))
  # one- or two-line plain-English description for each plot family (cf. Overall_Report.pdf)
  DESC <- c(
    "Top DE marker heatmap" =
      "Top differentially expressed genes per cell type (rows), scaled across types (columns). Bright red marks the type where each gene is most enriched — the molecular signature behind each label.",
    "Key lineage marker expression" =
      "Canonical lineage genes projected on the shared UMAP. Each panel lights up where one marker is expressed (the lead gene of each marker panel for this sample type), confirming the annotation spatially.",
    "SingleR reference heatmap" =
      "SingleR correlation scores of every cell (columns) against each reference label (rows). Strong diagonal blocks indicate confident, unambiguous assignments.",
    "QC: UMIs vs genes" =
      "Each dot is a cell: total UMIs vs genes detected, coloured by mitochondrial %. The dashed box is the acceptance window — cells outside it were filtered out.",
    "QC: UMIs vs % MT" =
      "UMIs vs mitochondrial fraction per cell. The dashed line is the %MT cutoff; stressed or dying cells (high MT, low UMI) sit above it and are removed.",
    "Doublets (UMAP)" =
      "Per-sample UMAP (pre-removal, from step 02) coloured by scDblFinder call. Red doublets tend to fall between lineages or in high-UMI regions and are dropped before integration. Counts reflect the full sample, not the plotting cap.",
    "Doublet score distribution" =
      "Histogram of scDblFinder doublet scores for the sample, coloured by called class. The singlet/doublet split shows where the score threshold fell.",
    "Highly variable genes" =
      sprintf("Mean expression vs standardized variance per gene; the 10 most variable are labelled. The dashed line marks standardized variance %s — the Overview HVG count is the number of genes above it. These variable genes drive PCA and clustering.",
              if (is.null(B$hvg_var_threshold)) "1.3" else B$hvg_var_threshold))
  desc_of <- function(name) if (!is.na(DESC[name])) sprintf('<p class="plot-desc">%s</p>\n', DESC[name]) else ""
  emit_fig <- function(uri, cap = NULL) {
    # caption (one line) ABOVE the image, description BELOW it — so two figures sharing a grid
    # row have their image tops flush regardless of how long each description is
    fc <- if (is.null(cap)) "" else sprintf('<figcaption>%s</figcaption>', htmltools::htmlEscape(cap))
    desc <- if (is.null(cap)) "" else desc_of(cap)
    alt <- if (is.null(cap)) "plot" else htmltools::htmlEscape(cap)
    cat(sprintf('\n<figure class="galfig">%s<img src="%s" alt="%s">%s</figure>\n', fc, uri, alt, desc))
  }
  if (length(G$stage)) {
    cat('\n# Stage galleries {#galleries}\n\n')
    cat('Regenerated from the saved objects. The SingleR panels stand in for the raw score heatmap (the pipeline does not keep the score matrix in the object).\n')
    for (t in names(G$stage)) {
      cat(sprintf('\n## %s {#stage-%s}\n\n', t, slug(t)))
      cat(desc_of(t))
      emit_fig(G$stage[[t]])
    }
  }
  if (length(G$by_sample)) {
    cat('\n# Per-sample detail {#per-sample}\n\n')
    cat('Pick a sample to load its diagnostics (so you do not scroll through every sample). The Overview cards, the summary table, and the left-nav sample links jump here too. Doublet panels appear only for samples whose doublet detection ran in this analysis; cache-loaded samples (pre-removed singlets) show the other diagnostics only.\n')
    sn <- names(G$by_sample)
    chips_ps <- paste(sprintf('<button class="selchip" data-psample="%s">%s</button>',
                              slug(sn), htmltools::htmlEscape(sn)), collapse = "")
    cat(sprintf('\n<div class="selrow psel"><span class="sellabel">Sample</span>%s</div>\n', chips_ps))
    for (s in sn) {
      cat(sprintf('\n## %s {#sample-%s}\n\n', s, slug(s)))
      cat('\n<div class="galgrid">\n')           # 2-up grid so a sample is not an endless column
      imgs <- G$by_sample[[s]]; for (t in names(imgs)) emit_fig(imgs[[t]], t)
      cat('\n</div>\n')
    }
    # show one sample at a time; reveal on chip click or on a #sample-<slug> deep-link
    cat('<script>(function(){var secs=document.querySelectorAll("#per-sample .level2");var chips=document.querySelectorAll(".psel .selchip");if(!secs.length)return;var hdr=document.getElementById("per-sample");function show(sl){secs.forEach(function(s){s.style.display=(s.id==="sample-"+sl)?"":"none";});chips.forEach(function(c){c.classList.toggle("on",c.getAttribute("data-psample")===sl);});}function goPS(sl){show(sl);if(hdr)hdr.scrollIntoView();}var valid={};chips.forEach(function(c){valid[c.getAttribute("data-psample")]=1;});chips.forEach(function(c){c.addEventListener("click",function(){goPS(c.getAttribute("data-psample"));});});function fromHash(){var m=(location.hash||"").match(/^#sample-(.+)$/);if(m&&valid[m[1]])goPS(m[1]);}window.addEventListener("hashchange",fromHash);if(/^#sample-/.test(location.hash)){fromHash();}else{show(chips[0].getAttribute("data-psample"));}})();</script>\n')
  }
}
```

```{r versions}
tv <- B$tool_versions
if (is.null(tv) || !nrow(tv)) {
  cat("Tool versions are unavailable for this run.")
} else {
  if ("Source" %in% names(tv))
    tv$Source <- sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a>',
                         tv$Source, sub("^https?://(www\\.)?", "", tv$Source))
```

```{r scrollspy, results='asis'}
cat('<script>
(function(){
  var links=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".report-nav a"));
  var secs=links.map(function(a){return document.querySelector(a.getAttribute("href"));});
  function onScroll(){
    var y=(window.scrollY||window.pageYOffset)+90, idx=0;
    for(var i=0;i<secs.length;i++){ if(secs[i] && secs[i].offsetParent!==null && secs[i].offsetTop<=y) idx=i; }
    links.forEach(function(a,i){ a.classList.toggle("active", i===idx); });
  }
  window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, {passive:true});
  window.addEventListener("load", onScroll); onScroll();
})();
</script>')
```
